summary: Customer requests full audit-log evidence package and ELK ingestion samples for ISO27001 attestation
description:
Issue summary: Customer (DataSight Analytics) requires a packaged evidence bundle covering retention, integrity, and delivery of platform audit logs to support an ISO27001 attestation.

Impact: Certification deadline approaching for customer compliance program; they need artifacts to present to auditors and to onboard logs into their ELK cluster for continuous monitoring. Delay risks blocking customer audit timeline.

Environment: Redwood hosted API (prod, us-east-1), account: datasight-prod (customer-managed S3 target for exports).

Request: 1) Canonical list of audit events emitted (schema + example lines), 2) Sample daily export (ndjson or gzip) covering a representative 24h window, 3) Recommended ELK index mapping and ingest pipeline examples, 4) IAM role/policy for S3 push and verification steps, 5) Statement describing retention policy, tamper-evidence controls, and log integrity checks, 6) Hashes/checksums for delivered bundle; PDF cover letter for auditors.

Requested artifacts (explicit): audit_event_schema.json, sample_audit_export_YYYY-MM-DD.ndjson(.gz), elk_index_mapping.json, s3_put_role_policy.json, retention_and_integrity_statement.pdf, evidence_manifest.txt.

Deadline: customer requested initial bundle by 2026-03-17 for their auditor intake on 2026-03-20.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-12 10:34 - Support intake: validated customer identity and requested scope; confirmed target S3 bucket arn:aws:s3:::datasight-logs-prod via support form.
2026-03-12 13:20 - Confirmed Redwood retention policy for audit logs: 365 days by default for account-level events; configurable for Dedicated/Private. Documented in runbook.
2026-03-13 09:05 - Export pipeline run: generated sample export covering 2026-03-11 UTC 00:00-23:59. Produced audit_sample_2026-03-11.ndjson.gz and computed SHA256 checksum.

2026-03-13 11:45 - Verified fields present in event schema: timestamp, tenant_id, request_id, principal, action, resource, outcome, model, region, ip_address, user_agent, kv_cache_metrics (when applicable). Noted optional user_metadata field for customer-provided tags.
2026-03-13 14:12 - Created ELK friendly index mapping with explicit date parsing and keyword/text splits for principal and resource fields. See elk_index_mapping.json.
2026-03-13 16:00 - S3 delivery: uploaded sample to customer-provided bucket using presigned PUT; validated object ACL and lifecycle rules. Generated role/policy example for direct account push.

2026-03-14 08:30 - Cross-team sync with Security/Compliance (Lina Cho) to confirm tamper-evidence controls: logs signed at rest using KMS envelope encryption; manifests include SHA256 and last-modified stamps. Added note about retention SLA and deletion record audit events.
comments: 2026-03-12 10:42 - Aisha (Support): Hi @datasight-sre, thanks for filing. We can deliver the bundle. Can you confirm the S3 bucket ARN and whether you prefer ndjson or gziped ndjson? Also confirm delivery method: direct push vs presigned upload.

2026-03-12 11:05 - Customer (Elena Morales, DataSight SRE): We prefer gzip ndjson and direct push to our bucket. Bucket ARN: arn:aws:s3:::datasight-logs-prod. We need index mapping for ELK ingest rules as well.
2026-03-13 09:30 - Marco (Eng - logs): Sample export generated and uploaded to a staging path. Uploaded file: audit_sample_2026-03-11.ndjson.gz. SHA256: 3b1f6d... (attached manifest).

2026-03-13 12:10 - Elena (DataSight): Received sample and ran it through our parser. Two fields flagged: user_agent contains long strings breaking tokenization, and kv_cache_metrics array needs flattening rule. Can you provide a recommended ingest pipeline to normalize these?

2026-03-13 14:40 - Marco (Eng): Uploaded elk_index_mapping.json and a suggested Logstash/ingest pipeline snippet (attached). Proposed normalization: user_agent -> user_agent.raw (keyword) + user_agent.text, kv_cache_metrics -> kv_cache_hit_ratio (float) and kv_cache_size (int) extraction rules.

2026-03-14 09:02 - Elena: Thanks. Our auditor asked for a short statement on how Redwood assures log integrity and how we can verify object immutability. Can you add a one-page retention and integrity statement?
2026-03-14 09:20 - Aisha (Support): Noted, I asked Security to draft the statement. ETA for statement: 2026-03-15 EOD.
resolution_notes: Partial delivery provided 2026-03-13: sample export uploaded to customer S3 and ELK index mapping supplied. Pending items: formal retention_and_integrity_statement.pdf from Security (ETA 2026-03-15), and creation of automated monthly exports. Follow-up actions assigned: Marco to hand off automation task to Platform Ops (INT ticket recommended). After customer confirms ingest mapping, Support will close this ticket and produce final auditor cover letter.
notes_for_follow_up: Create INT ticket for Ops to implement monthly signed export to customer S3 with lifecycle rules (recommended retention 365 days).
Security to produce retention_and_integrity_statement.pdf and include KMS key ID and manifest verification steps.
After automation is in place, schedule a 30-minute handover call with DataSight SRE to walk through ingestion and verification steps.
